933698

2/
The articles specifically listed in
Annex "A" as classified under Section 104 of the Tariff
and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be accorded
a 10% Margin of Preference (MOP) as shown in Column 9 of
said Annex "A".
Accordingly, such articles shall be
subject to the Preferential Tariffs indicated in Columns
SEC. 2. In the event that any subsequent changes are
made in the basic Philippine rate of duty on any of the
articles listed in Annex "A", such articles shall be
automatically accorded the corresponding MOP indicated in
Column 9 of said Annex "A"
SEC. 3. The MoP indicated in Column 9 of Annex "A"
shall apply only to imports from participants in the
Agreement on the GSTP as defined in Article I (a) thereof.
SEC. 4. After the effective date of this Order; all
the above-described articles entered or withdrawn from
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be
subject to qualification under the Rules of Origin as
prescribed in the Agreement on the GSTP.
SEC. 5. This Order shall take effect on 1 January
1994. Done in the City of Manila, this 276,

in the year of our Lord, Nineteen Hundred an Ninety-Three.
